description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data instances across different categories within the Darija Open Dataset Version 2. The chart contains six slices, representing “Semantic Roles,” “Syntactic Sentences,” “Translated + Augmented Data,” “Extra + Translations,” “Pending Translations,” and a category without a label. The slices are colored purple, yellow, light green, light blue, and a darker green, respectively. Numerical values are displayed alongside three of the slices: 23,108 for “Semantic Roles”, 43,000 for “Extra + Translations”, and 45,387 for “Translated + Augmented Data”, while “Syntactic Sentences” is labeled with 30,000. The chart includes a legend identifying each category by color and label. The slices appear to be ordered visually in a clockwise direction, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not explicitly indicated.
